risks.title: Macroeconomic volatility
risks.score_rationale: Company explicitly mentions impact of volatile worldwide economic conditions on business due to semiconductor demand uncertainty. Language used indicates material and adverse impact, with terms such as unpredictable spending patterns (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Global macroeconomic conditions, including volatility in semiconductor demand and economic uncertainties, can materially and adversely impact the company's business, financial condition and operating results

risks.title: Geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: Company explicitly mentions geopolitical conflict risks, including Israel-Gaza conflict, with potential negative impact on operations in Israel (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Geopolitical conflicts, particularly regional tensions, may negatively impact the company's operations in affected geographic areas

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Company mentions cybersecurity incident risks related to geopolitical tensions but does not classify as critical risk (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Cybersecurity incidents may negatively impact company operations, particularly in regions affected by geopolitical tensions

risks.title: Supply chain concentration
risks.score_rationale: Company mentions supply chain risks including dependence on single suppliers and demand volatility impacts on inventory and procurement (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Supply chain may be affected by single supplier dependence and demand volatility, requiring careful inventory and commitment management

risks.title: Competitive pressure
risks.score_rationale: Company mentions competition from established competitors and new market entrants in semiconductor equipment and packaging materials sectors (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Competition in semiconductor assembly equipment and packaging materials markets may negatively impact sales and profitability

risks.title: Pricing volatility
risks.score_rationale: Company mentions pricing pressure risks from competitive forces and cost reduction requirements (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Price volatility may negatively impact revenues and profitability due to competitive pressure and cost reduction requirements

risks.title: Product development
risks.score_rationale: Company mentions product development risks including need to meet customer requirements and maintain competitive advantage (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Product development is critical for maintaining competitiveness but involves execution risks in meeting customer specifications and market needs
